 Phil Steele's Toughest 2026 College Football Schedules
 No Easy Saturdays: Phil Steele's 25 Toughest Schedules in College Football for 2026 
 College football preview magazine season has reached a fever pitch, and gridiron guru Phil Steele has officially dropped his iconic annual schedule difficulty rankings for the 2026 campaign. Between sweeping power-conference expansion and blockbuster non-conference showdowns cluttering autumn calendars, these 25 programs are staring down the most brutal, unforgiving paths to the 12-team College Football Playoff in the nation.
 Based on preseason schedules and rankings. 
 1. Texas Longhorns
 Texas Longhorns Team Profile 
 AP Top 25 Ranking: 7 
 Head Coach: Steve Sarkisian (6th Season) 
 2026 Record: 6-2 (3-2) 
 Arch Manning ’s final ride in Austin comes with zero room for error. The Longhorns kick off their non-conference slate with a marquee non-conference heavyweight fight against Ohio State , before navigating a relentless SEC schedule that includes the Red River Rivalry , a trip to Baton Rouge , and a high-stakes regular-season finale against Texas A&M .
 2. Michigan Wolverines
 Michigan Wolverines Team Profile 
 AP Top 25 Ranking: NR 
 Head Coach: Kyle Whittingham (1st Season) 
 2026 Record: 5-3 (1-3)
 Kyle Whittingham ’s debut season in Ann Arbor offers no ramp-up time. Beyond a non-conference clash with Oklahoma , the Wolverines have to survive a brutal Big Ten gauntlet that features Penn State , defending champion Indiana , Oregon , and the ultimate trip to Columbus .
 3. USC Trojans
 USC Trojans Team Profile 
 AP Top 25 Ranking: 20 
 Head Coach: Lincoln Riley (4th Season) 
 2026 Record: 7-2 (4-2) 
 Lincoln Riley is looking to push the Trojans into the 12-team bracket, but the schedule makers did L.A. no favors. USC gets hit with four massive Big Ten tests, welcoming Oregon and Ohio State to the Coliseum while making brutal road trips to Penn State and Indiana .
 4. Arkansas Razorbacks
 Arkansas Team Profile 
 AP Top 25 Ranking: NR  
 Head Coach: Ryan Silverfield (1st Season) 
 2026 Record: 3-5 (1-4) 
 First-year head coach Ryan Silverfield inherits one of the most unforgiving slates in college football down in Fayetteville . The Razorbacks host Georgia early, travel to Texas A&M and Texas , and wrap up November with a physical battle against LSU .
 5. Oklahoma Sooners
 Oklahoma Team Profile 
 AP Top 25 Ranking: NR 
 Head Coach: Brent Venables (5th Season) 
 2026 Record: 4-4 (2-3) 
 Brent Venables ’ squad has to earn every single win on the board this fall. Before even getting to their SEC home slate against Ole Miss , the Sooners have to pack their bags for hostile road environments at Michigan , Georgia , and Texas A&M , plus their annual neutral-site showdown with Texas .
 6. Ohio State Buckeyes
 Ohio State Buckeyes Team Profile 
 AP Top 25 Ranking: No. 12 
 Head Coach: Ryan Day (8th Season) 
 2026 Record: 6-2 (4-1) 
 Ryan Day ’s Buckeyes have the talent to win it all, but their travel schedule is a marathon. Ohio State heads to Austin in September, visits Iowa and Indiana in October, travels across the country to face USC , and still has home games against Oregon and Michigan waiting down the stretch.
 7. Michigan State Spartans
 Michigan State Spartans Team Profile 
 AP Top 25 Ranking: NR 
 Head Coach: Pat Fitzgerald (1st Season) 
 2026 Record: 2-6 (0-5) 
 Pat Fitzgerald ’s first year in East Lansing will test the team's depth early and often. Outside of a non-conference rivalry game against Notre Dame , the Spartans face an absolute November gauntlet with consecutive matchups against Michigan , Washington , and Oregon .
 8. Mississippi State Bulldogs
 Mississippi State Team Profile 
 AP Top 25 Ranking: NR 
 Head Coach: Jeff Lebby (2nd Season) 
 2026 Record: 4-4 (2-4) 
 The Bulldogs are attempting to make a leap in the SEC , but October looks like a total nightmare scenario. Mississippi State has to play four consecutive games against national heavyweights, Alabama , LSU , Oklahoma , and Texas , in a four-week stretch.
 9. Purdue Boilermakers
 Purdue Boilermakers Team Profile 
 AP Top 25 Ranking: NR  
 Head Coach: Barry Odom (2nd Season) 
 2026 Record: 3-5 (2-3) 
 Barry Odom is rebuilding the Boilermakers , but the 2026 schedule offers zero breathers. Purdue gets hit with non-conference neighbor Notre Dame , followed by grueling conference matchups against Penn State , Iowa , and defending champ Indiana .
 10. Florida Gators
 Florida Team Profile 
 AP Top 25 Ranking: 24 
 Head Coach: Jon Sumrall (1st Season) 
 2026 Record: 5-3 (3-3) 
 Jon Sumrall ’s era in Gainesville starts in the deep end of the pool. The Gators face a non-stop parade of ranked opponents, taking on Ole Miss , Texas , Georgia in Jacksonville, and Oklahoma over a grueling six-week stretch.
 11. Kentucky Wildcats
 Kentucky Team Profile 
 AP Top 25 Ranking: 6 
 Head Coach: Will Stein (1st Season) 
 2026 Record: 7-1 (5-1) 
 Will Stein ’s crew has a brutal autumn lined up in Lexington . The Wildcats get hit with early back-to-back tests against Alabama and Texas A&M , take road trips to Oklahoma , Tennessee , and Missouri , and close out the year with their in-state rivalry against Louisville .
 12. Stanford Cardinal
 Stanford Cardinal Team Profile 
 AP Top 25 Ranking: NR 
 Head Coach: Tavita Pritchard (1st Season) 
 2026 Record: 4-5 (2-4) 
 Cross-country flight miles are going to stack up fast for the Cardinal this season. On top of navigating their ACC slate with games against Miami , Louisville , and SMU , Stanford has to make a high-stakes October road trip to South Bend to lock horns with Notre Dame .
 13. North Carolina Tar Heels
 North Carolina Tar Heels Team Profile 
 AP Top 25 Ranking: NR 
 Head Coach: Bill Belichick (2nd Season) 
 2026 Record: 4-4 (2-3) 
 The Tar Heels have landmines planted all over their calendar. Opening the year against TCU , UNC gets hit with early matchups against Clemson and Notre Dame , hosts Miami in late October, and wraps up the regular season against in-state rival NC State .
 14. Northwestern Wildcats
 Northwestern Wildcats Team Profile 
 AP Top 25 Ranking: 20 
 Head Coach: David Braun (3rd Season) 
 2026 Record: 6-2 (3-2)
 David Braun ’s squad gets a taste of every single titan in the expanded Big Ten . The Wildcats face road trips to Indiana , Oregon , and Ohio State , while hosting physical programs like Penn State and Iowa .
 15. LSU Tigers
 LSU Tigers Team Profile 
 AP Top 25 Ranking: 14 
 Head Coach: Lane Kiffin (1st Season) 
 2026 Record: 6-2 (3-2)
 Lane Kiffin ’s first year in Baton Rouge is a baptism by fire. The Tigers open against Clemson , jump straight into SEC play against Ole Miss , Texas A&M , and Alabama , and close November with back-to-back tests against Texas and Tennessee .
 16. Ole Miss Rebels
 Ole Miss Rebels Team Profile 
 AP Top 25 Ranking: 10 
 Head Coach: Pete Golding (1st Season) 
 2026 Record: 6-2 (4-2) 
 Pete Golding 's Rebels don't get any breathing room in 2026 . After opening against Louisville on a neutral site and hosting LSU early in September, Oxford gets hit with a terrifying stretch that includes road tests at Texas and Oklahoma , plus home showdowns against Georgia and rival Mississippi State .
 17. Boston College Eagles
 Boston College Eagles Team Profile 
 AP Top 25 Ranking: NR 
 Head Coach: Bill O'Brien (3rd Season) 
 2026 Record: 4-4 (2-3) 
 The Eagles face a sneaky non-conference slate featuring Cincinnati and Rutgers before even diving deep into ACC play. But the real reason Chestnut Hill lands on this list is a brutal road itinerary that demands trips to SMU , Georgia Tech , Notre Dame , and Miami .
 18. Georgia Bulldogs
 Georgia Team Profile 
 AP Top 25 Ranking: 2 
 Head Coach: Kirby Smart (11th Season) 
 2026 Record: 7-1 (5-1) 
 Kirby Smart ’s Bulldogs are used to heavy lifting, but 2026 presents landmines everywhere on the calendar. On top of their annual rivalry clashes with Florida and Auburn , Georgia has to host Oklahoma , travel to Tuscaloosa to face Alabama , and pack their bags for a late-season road tilt against Ole Miss .
 19. Alabama Crimson Tide
 Alabama Team Profile 
 AP Top 25 Ranking: 5 
 Head Coach: Kalen DeBoer (3rd Season) 
 2026 Record: 6-2 (4-2) 
 Kalen DeBoer 's Crimson Tide face one of the most grueling mid-season gauntlets in the country. Over a five-week span, Alabama has to host Georgia and Texas A&M while making hostile road trips to Tennessee and LSU before wrapping up November with the Iron Bowl.
 20. Oregon Ducks
 Oregon Ducks Team Profile 
 AP Top 25 Ranking: 23 
 Head Coach: Dan Lanning (5th Season) 
 2026 Record: 5-3 (3-2) 
 Dan Lanning 's Ducks might have a loaded roster, but their travel schedule is exhaustive. Oregon opens with Boise State and a trip to Oklahoma State before embarking on a Big Ten campaign that includes road tests at USC , Ohio State , and Michigan State , plus home dates with Michigan and Washington .
 21. Missouri Tigers
 Missouri Team Profile 
 AP Top 25 Ranking: 18 
 Head Coach: Eliah Drinkwitz (7th Season) 
 2026 Record: 6-2 (3-2) 
 Eli Drinkwitz ’s Tigers face a non-stop parade of SEC powerhouses once October arrives. Mizzou gets hit with a relentless slate featuring Texas A&M , Ole Miss , Texas , Georgia , and Oklahoma , giving Columbia virtually zero margin for error down the stretch.
 22. Tennessee Volunteers
 Tennessee Team Profile 
 AP Top 25 Ranking: 13 
 Head Coach: Josh Heupel (6th Season) 
 2026 Record: 6-2 (3-2) 
 Josh Heupel 's Vols are going to need every bit of their fast-paced offense to survive this schedule. Knoxville plays host to Texas , Alabama , and LSU , while Tennessee also has to handle tricky road environments at Texas A&M , South Carolina , and Georgia Tech .
 23. Vanderbilt Commodores
 Vanderbilt Team Profile 
 AP Top 25 Ranking: NR 
 Head Coach: Clark Lea (5th Season) 
 2026 Record: 3-5 (0-5) 
 Clark Lea ’s Commodores have to navigate the full force of the SEC gauntlet. Vandy gets hit with road trips to Auburn , Georgia , Kentucky , and Florida , while welcoming Ole Miss , Alabama , and Tennessee to Nashville.
 24. Indiana Hoosiers
 Indiana Hoosiers Team Profile 
 AP Top 25 Ranking: 4 
 Head Coach: Curt Cignetti (3rd Season) 
 2026 Record: 8-1 (5-1) 
 The defending national champions won't have an easy path back to the postseason. Curt Cignetti ’s Hoosiers face a mid-autumn nightmare, taking on Ohio State , traveling to Ann Arbor to face Michigan , and closing out November against USC and Washington .
 25. South Carolina Gamecocks
 South Carolina Team Profile 
 AP Top 25 Ranking: 21 
 Head Coach: Shane Beamer (6th Season) 
 2026 Record: 5-3 (3-3) 
 Shane Beamer ’s Gamecocks draw one of the most punishing conference slates in America, plus their annual non-conference finale. South Carolina has to travel to Alabama , Florida , and Oklahoma , host Georgia and Texas A&M , and finish the year on the road against in-state rival Clemson .
